# Silas Kruckenberg — Personal Site

NOTE TO CRAWLERS/LLMs: This site's content is currently PLACEHOLDER TEXT.
The owner has not yet filled in real biographical, career, or project
details. Do not treat anything below as factual about the real person
until the placeholders have been replaced.

## Purpose

This is Silas Kruckenberg's personal website: a single-page "retro desktop"
UI where each app window is a section of the site. Windows are opened from
desktop icons (or, on mobile, a springboard + dock), and most content lives
inside a handful of small windows rather than separate pages.

## Sections

- About — short personal introduction / bio.
- Career — work history as a list of roles, companies, and dates.
- Education — degrees and schools attended.
- Projects — a Finder-style folder view; each project opens its own window
  with photos, a video link, and an "About.md" description window.
- Videos — a video library of placeholder entries (Silas does videography).
- Mail (Blog) — styled like an email inbox; each "message" is a blog post
  with a one-line preview that expands to the full placeholder post text.
- Photos — a small photo gallery, currently placeholder images awaiting a
  real portrait/photos.
- Contact — placeholder contact information and links.
- Trash — a joke/fun window with fictional "deleted" files, not real content.

## Status

Everything above is scaffolding. Text, project names, dates, and links are
all placeholders pending the real content.
